ja: 来週の研修の資料、まとめていただけないかと思っていたのですが。
en: I was wondering if you could put together the materials for next week's training.
alternatives: I was hoping you could put together the materials for next week's training.
Would you mind putting together the materials for next week's training?
point: was wondering if you could で丁寧に依頼を切り出す

ja: 彼はその仕事を引き受ける前に、締め切りを確認しておくべきでしたね。
en: He should have checked the deadline before he agreed to take on that job.
alternatives: He should have checked the deadline before accepting that job.
He should've looked at the deadline before he took that job on.
point: 過去にしなかった後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: ごめんなさい、今週はとても忙しいので、プレゼン資料作りは手伝えないんです。
en: Sorry, I can't help you with the slides because I'm really busy this week.
alternatives: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy this week to help with the slides.
Sorry, I'm really busy this week, so I can't help with the presentation slides.
point: 「〜を手伝う」は help you with the slides の語順

ja: こちらで締め切りを一週間延ばせるとしても、この翻訳をお願いするのはやはり難しいですか？
en: Even if we could push the deadline back a week, would it still be hard for you to take on this translation?
alternatives: Even if we pushed the deadline back a week, would it still be difficult for you to take on this translation?
Would it still be hard for you to handle this translation even if we could extend the deadline by a week?
point: 仮定の「としても」は even if に could を合わせ、主節は would

ja: この件は、経理に詳しい田中さんに頼んだほうがいいですよ。
en: You should ask Tanaka, who knows a lot about accounting, to handle this.
alternatives: It'd be best to ask Tanaka, who knows a lot about accounting, to handle this.
You should leave this to Tanaka, who knows a lot about accounting.
point: 人に説明を足すときはカンマ＋who で補足する

ja: あなたがもっと早く頼んでくれていたら、私は金曜までに仕上げられたのに。
en: If you had asked me sooner, I could have finished it by Friday.
alternatives: If you'd asked me earlier, I could've gotten it done by Friday.
If you'd come to me sooner, I would have been able to finish it by Friday.
point: 過去の事実に反する仮定は had asked と could have finished

ja: この仕事、喜んで引き受けますが、データの整理は私のアシスタントにやってもらってもいいですか？
en: I'm happy to take this on, but would it be okay if I had my assistant sort out the data?
alternatives: I'd be happy to take this on, but is it okay if I get my assistant to organize the data?
I'm glad to take this on, but could I have my assistant sort out the data?
point: 人にやってもらうは have 人＋動詞の原形

ja: この翻訳、もっと早くお願いしておけばよかったです。締め切りは明日なんです。
en: I wish I had asked you to translate this sooner. The deadline is tomorrow.
alternatives: I wish I'd asked you to translate this earlier. The deadline is tomorrow.
I should have asked you to translate this sooner. The deadline is tomorrow.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish のあとを過去完了に

ja: 予算の条件を確認したうえで、私たちはその案件を来月から引き受けることにしました。
en: Having checked the budget, we decided to take on the project starting next month.
alternatives: Having confirmed the budget terms, we decided to take on the project from next month.
After going over the budget, we decided to take the project on starting next month.
point: 先に済ませた動作は Having checked で表す

ja: 先週お願いした見積もりがまだ届いていないので、今日中に送っていただけますか？
en: I asked for the quote last week, but I still haven't received it, so could you send it by the end of today?
alternatives: I asked you for the quote last week, but it still hasn't arrived. Could you send it by the end of today?
I requested the quote last week and still haven't gotten it, so could you send it over by the end of the day?
point: 頼んだのは過去形、まだ届いていないは現在完了

ja: 私たちが本当に必要としているのは、金曜までにこのデータを確認してくれる人です。
en: What we really need is someone who can check this data by Friday.
alternatives: What we really need is someone to check this data by Friday.
The thing we really need is someone who can check this data by Friday.
point: 「〜なのは」は What で始めて is でつなぐ

ja: 来週までに予算が承認されるなら喜んで引き受けます、と私から先方に伝えました。
en: I told the client I'd be happy to take it on as long as the budget was approved by next week.
alternatives: I told the client that I'd gladly take it on if the budget was approved by next week.
I let the client know I'd be happy to take it on provided the budget got approved by next week.
point: told に合わせて will は would、is は was に時制をそろえる

ja: 部長がその依頼を引き受けるのをためらったのは、仕事の量ではなく、締め切りの短さのせいだったんです。
en: It wasn't the amount of work but the tight deadline that made our department head hesitate to take on the request.
alternatives: It was the tight deadline, not the amount of work, that made our department head hesitate to take on the request.
What made our department head hesitate to take on the request wasn't the amount of work but the tight deadline.
point: It wasn't A but B that の語順で強調する

ja: クライアントから月曜までに署名するよう言われているので、金曜までに契約書を確認していただけないでしょうか。
en: I was wondering if you could review the contract by Friday, since the client has asked us to sign it by Monday.
alternatives: Would you mind reviewing the contract by Friday? The client has asked us to sign it by Monday.
I was hoping you could look over the contract by Friday, because the client wants us to sign it by Monday.
point: 丁寧な依頼は I was wondering if you could で過去形にぼかす

ja: 翻訳をお願いしたくて、私は朝からずっと佐藤さんに電話しているんです。
en: I've been calling Mr. Sato all morning to ask for a translation.
alternatives: I've been calling Ms. Sato all morning to ask for a translation.
I've been trying to reach Mr. Sato since this morning to ask for a translation.
point: 朝から続けている動作は I've been calling

ja: 部長が頼んだ時には、彼女はもう別の案件を引き受けていました。
en: She had already taken on another project when the manager asked her.
alternatives: When the manager asked her, she had already taken on another project.
By the time the manager asked her, she'd already agreed to another project.
point: 頼まれた時点より前の完了は had + 過去分詞

ja: 彼女はその依頼を引き受けてくれただけでなく、週末も手伝うと申し出てくれました。
en: Not only did she take on the job, but she also offered to help over the weekend.
alternatives: She not only agreed to the request but also offered to help over the weekend.
Not only did she accept the request, but she also offered to help on the weekend.
point: Not only を文頭に置くと did she の語順になる

ja: もし来週の水曜まで時間をもらえるとしたら、翻訳を引き受けられるんですが、今週は無理です。
en: If you gave me until next Wednesday, I could take on the translation, but I can't do it this week.
alternatives: If I had until next Wednesday, I could take on the translation, but this week just isn't possible.
I could handle the translation if you gave me until next Wednesday, but I can't manage it this week.
point: 仮の条件は if 節を過去形、主節を could にする

ja: そのデータ入力の作業は、来週外部の会社に任されることになっています。
en: The data entry work will be handed over to an outside company next week.
alternatives: The data entry work is going to be outsourced to another company next week.
Next week, the data entry work will be given to an outside company.
point: 作業が「任される」側なので will be + 過去分詞の受動態

ja: もし彼があの時その依頼を断っていたら、今ごろこんなに忙しくはなかったでしょうね。
en: If he had turned down that request back then, he wouldn't be this busy now.
alternatives: If he'd said no to that request back then, he wouldn't be so busy now.
If he'd declined that request back then, he wouldn't be this busy right now.
point: if 節は過去完了、主節は今の話なので wouldn't be
